sloka: विभीषणस्य तु वचस्तछ्रुत्वा रघुसत्तमः ।अन्वीक्ष्य मनसा सर्वमिदम् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-१९-१७॥।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasya tu vacastachrutvā raghusattamaḥ ।anvīkṣya manasā sarvamidam vacanamabravīt ॥6-19-17॥।।

translations.english: "Rama, you are exceptional in excusing Vibheeshana. Realize that he has been dispatched here by Ravana. I consider befitting for you to captivate him."
